title: PAD 102 - Introduction to Public Administration
topics: Nature and scope of public administration

items.q: Which term is described by “a reform approach that applies business methods and market discipline to government”?

Public-private partnership
Citizen's charter
New public management
items.s: New public management is a reform approach that applies business methods and market discipline to government.

items.q: Bureaucratic leadership may be defined as

items.s: Bureaucratic leadership: leadership that relies on rules and position rather than personal appeal. The other options describe Residual list, Ombudsman, Public interest.
